query: CI on my PR is red: api-tests shows cancelled after 25 minutes. My diff only changes a Markdown file in docs/. What do I do?
expected_behavior: Does not conclude that the diff caused the failure, and does not start to edit code
Starts at docs/ci-flakiness.md and reads Family 6 and Family 5, which are the two opposite shapes of a cancelled job
Uses the [ci-pressure] telemetry to tell a wedge (scopes=0.0/min with self cpu=0.0%) from a collapse that keeps finishing tests, and checks whether api-tests-postgres passed on the same commit
Does not treat per-test or per-suite durations in the log as evidence of a slow test
Treats a new occurrence as a finding to record, because Family 5 is closed for monitoring and Family 6 is fixed
